Name: Login
User Story: As a Guest, I want to log in to SaveBite with my registered email and password, so that I can securely access the platform features and data authorized for my role.

Name: Forget Password
User Story: As a Guest, I want to submit my registered email address to request a password reset, so that I can receive a secure verification code to regain access to my account.

Name: Verify Password Reset
User Story: As a Guest, I want to verify the password-reset OTP code and enter a new password, so that I can securely reset my credentials and regain access to my account.

Name: Register
User Story: As a Guest, I want to register for a new SaveBite customer account with valid personal details, so that an activation verification code is sent to my email.

Name: Verify Registration
User Story: As a Guest, I want to submit the verification code sent to my email, so that my account is verified, activated, and initialized with default customer trust metrics.

Name: View Nearby Stores
User Story: As a Guest, I want to view active food stores located near my current GPS location or selected address, so that I can discover nearby vendors offering surplus meals.

Name: View Store Profile
User Story: As a Guest, I want to view a store's public profile, business hours, address, and overall ratings, so that I can assess the vendor before ordering.

Name: View Store's Flash Deals
User Story: As a Guest, I want to view all active Flash Deals offered by a specific store, so that I can explore available surplus meal offers from that store.

Name: View Store Reviews
User Story: As a Guest, I want to browse customer ratings, comments, and photos for a store, so that I can evaluate its food quality and service reliability.

Name: View Flash Deals By Current Location
User Story: As a Guest, I want to browse, search by keyword, and filter available Flash Deals by category, price, distance, and location mode, so that I can quickly find suitable surplus food rescue deals.

Name: View Flash Deal Details
User Story: As a Guest, I want to view comprehensive details of a Flash Deal including item variants, discount pricing, remaining quantity, and pickup time window, so that I can make an informed purchasing decision.

Name: Logout
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to log out of my active session, so that my access token and refresh token are revoked to prevent unauthorized access.

Name: Change Password
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to change my current account password by verifying my old password, so that I can maintain the ongoing security of my account.

Name: View Profile
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view my profile details including full name, email, phone number, and avatar, so that I can check my account information.

Name: Edit Profile
User Story: As a Customer, I want to update my personal contact information such as full name and phone number, so that my profile records stay current.

Name: Update Avatar
User Story: As a Customer, I want to upload a new profile picture, so that I can personalize my account avatar displayed across SaveBite.

Name: View addresses
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view my saved delivery and pickup reference addresses along with their GPS coordinates, so that I can manage my saved locations.

Name: Add New Address
User Story: As a Customer, I want to add a new address with contact details and exact GPS coordinates, so that I can use it to calculate accurate travel times and find nearby deals.

Name: Update Address
User Story: As a Customer, I want to update an existing saved address and its map coordinates, so that my location and recipient information remain accurate.

Name: Delete Address
User Story: As a Customer, I want to delete a saved address that I no longer need, so that my address list remains clean and organized.

Name: Set Default Address
User Story: As a Customer, I want to designate one saved address as my default location, so that it is automatically selected for calculating distances to stores.

Name: View Notifications
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to view my in-app notifications and real-time alerts, so that I can stay updated on order status changes, nearby deals, and account events.

Name: Mark Notification as Read
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to mark a specific notification as read, so that I can track which updates I have already reviewed.

Name: Delete Notification
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to delete an unwanted notification, so that I can keep my notification feed tidy.

Name: Mark All Notifications as Read
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to mark all unread notifications as read with a single action, so that I can clear my unread notification badge.

Name: View items in cart
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view Flash Deal items currently placed in my cart grouped by store, so that I can review my intended purchases before checkout.

Name: Update Item Quantity
User Story: As a Customer, I want to adjust the quantity of an item in my cart within available stock limits, so that my cart matches my purchasing requirements.

Name: Remove Item from Cart
User Story: As a Customer, I want to remove an item from my cart, so that I can remove unwanted items before initiating checkout.

Name: Add Flash Deal to Cart
User Story: As a Customer, I want to add an available Flash Deal variant to my cart, so that I can assemble items from a store for purchase.

Name: Checkout Order
User Story: As a Customer, I want to checkout my cart items for a selected store, validate my travel route against the pickup deadline, and place an order, so that items are reserved.

Name: Payment
User Story: As a Customer, I want to complete payment online via PayOS for the required order amount or trust-level deposit, so that my order is submitted to the store for fulfillment.

Name: View Order History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view my past and active orders filtered by status tabs, so that I can track the progress of my meal rescue orders.

Name: View Order Details
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the full details of an order including purchased items, store pickup deadline, remaining cash balance, and store address, so that I can collect my food on time.

Name: Cancel Order
User Story: As a Customer, I want to cancel an eligible order prior to its pickup deadline, so that I can cancel an order I am unable to pick up in accordance with platform cancellation rules.

Name: View Customer Payment History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the transaction history of my personal payments and deposits, so that I can monitor my online spending and payment statuses.

Name: View Payment Details
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view detailed transaction records for an order payment, so that I can verify the amount paid, payment method, transaction code, and timestamp.

Name: View Refund History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the history of all my refund requests and their processing statuses, so that I can monitor refunds owed to me.

Name: Request Refund
User Story: As a Customer, I want to submit a refund request with reasons and photographic evidence for a Completed order within 6 hours, so that I can be reimbursed for problematic or substandard food.

Name: Provide Bank Information
User Story: As a Customer, I want to provide my bank account details or upload a VietQR code for an approved refund, so that the store can transfer the refund amount to me.

Name: Confirm Refund via Email
User Story: As a Customer, I want to confirm my refund receiving account details using an email verification code, so that unauthorized destination changes are prevented.

Name: Withdraw Refund Request
User Story: As a Customer, I want to withdraw a pending refund request, so that I can cancel my dispute if the issue with the store has been resolved directly.

Name: View Refund Details
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the complete details, audit timeline, and transfer proof image of a refund, so that I can verify the reimbursement progress.

Name: Add Feedback
User Story: As a Customer, I want to submit star ratings, textual comments, and photos for a Completed order, so that I can share my dining experience and inform other customers.

Name: View Feedback History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view all feedback and reviews I have previously submitted, so that I can review my ratings and see store responses.

Name: Edit Feedback
User Story: As a Customer, I want to edit feedback I previously submitted, so that my review remains truthful and reflective of my experience.

Name: Delete Feedback
User Story: As a Customer, I want to delete feedback I previously submitted, so that I can retract reviews I no longer wish to share publicly.

Name: View Trust Score and Level
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view my current Trust Score, reputation tier (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond), and active deposit policy, so that I understand my platform standing.

Name: Track Level Progress
User Story: As a Customer, I want to track my progression toward the next Trust Level based on completed orders and reliability metrics, so that I know what criteria are needed to unlock lower deposit rates.

Name: View Trust Score History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the chronological log of trust point additions and deductions, so that I can understand how my actions have impacted my score.

Name: View Level Info & Benefits
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the requirements and deposit benefits for all platform Trust Levels, so that I can see the perks of maintaining high reliability.

Name: View Penalty History
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view my history of No-Show and late cancellation penalties, so that I understand previous infractions that affected my account.

Name: Track Penalty Recovery Progress
User Story: As a Customer, I want to track my recovery progress toward clearing a penalty through consecutive successful order pickups, so that I can restore my account standing.

Name: Register Shop
User Story: As a Customer, I want to submit a store registration application with business details, operating hours, and legal identity documents, so that I can apply to operate a store on SaveBite.

Name: View Shop Registration Status
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the review status and administrator feedback on my store application, so that I know whether it is approved, rejected, or needs revision.

Name: Edit and Resubmit Shop Registration
User Story: As a Customer, I want to update required business information or re-upload documents for a flagged application, so that I can resubmit it for administrator review.

Name: Cancel Shop Registration
User Story: As a Customer, I want to cancel my pending store registration application, so that I can withdraw my request before it is reviewed.

Name: View Received Staff Invitations
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view staff invitations sent to my account by store owners, so that I can review opportunities to join store teams.

Name: Accept Staff Invitation
User Story: As a Customer, I want to accept a valid staff invitation after concluding any active staff role at another store, so that I can join the store's staff team.

Name: Decline Staff Invitation
User Story: As a Customer, I want to decline a staff invitation sent to me, so that I can formally refuse a store employment offer.

Name: Follow Shop
User Story: As a Customer, I want to follow a store, so that I can stay updated on its surplus food offers and receive notifications when new Flash Deals are posted.

Name: Unfollow Shop
User Story: As a Customer, I want to unfollow a store I previously followed, so that I stop receiving deal alerts and promotional updates from that store.

Name: Manage Shop Notification Settings
User Story: As a Customer, I want to toggle deal alert notifications on or off for a followed store, so that I can manage my notification frequency without unfollowing.

Name: View Followed Shops
User Story: As a Customer, I want to view the list of all stores I am currently following, so that I can quickly access their profiles and active menus.

Name: View Flash Deals for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view all active, scheduled, and past Flash Deals for my store, so that I can monitor surplus inventory on sale.

Name: View Flash Deal Details for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view detailed configuration, remaining quantities, and pickup intervals of a store Flash Deal, so that I can prepare for customer pickups.

Name: View Shop Orders
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view orders placed for my store filtered by status and pickup date, so that I can manage fulfillment workflows.

Name: Search Order by ID
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to search for an order by its order code or identifier, so that I can quickly look up the order when a customer arrives at the store.

Name: View Order Details for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view complete details of an order including ordered items, payment status, customer contact, and pickup deadline, so that I can prepare and verify the handover.

Name: Confirm Order
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to confirm a Pending order within 5 minutes after payment, so that the store commits to preparing the order before it expires.

Name: Reject Order
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to reject a Pending order with a clear reason, so that reserved stock is released and the customer is refunded.

Name: Update Preparation Status
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to advance an order's status to Preparing or ReadyForPickup, so that the customer is notified in real time to come collect their food.

Name: Complete Order
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to mark an order as Completed upon handing over the food and collecting any remaining cash balance, so that the transaction is finalized.

Name: Generate Remaining Payment QR
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to generate a dynamic VietQR code for the remaining balance of a PayAtShop order, so that the customer can settle the remaining amount via bank transfer at pickup.

Name: View Shop and Staff Info
User Story: As a Staff member, I want to view my assigned store profile and store team information, so that I can check my working assignment and store details.

Name: Leave Shop
User Story: As a Staff member, I want to leave a store where I am employed, so that I can end my staff membership when I no longer work at that store.

Name: View Feedback for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view customer feedback and star ratings submitted for our store, so that we can evaluate customer satisfaction and food quality.

Name: Reply Feedback
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to post an official reply to customer feedback, so that our store can thank customers or resolve reported complaints.

Name: Edit Reply
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to edit a previously posted reply to customer feedback, so that our store's response remains polite and accurate.

Name: Delete Reply
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to delete a reply previously posted to customer feedback, so that an outdated or inaccurate response can be removed.

Name: View Restock Tasks
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to view the list of surplus food items from expired, cancelled, or No-Show orders requiring resale evaluation, so that edible food is not wasted.

Name: Make Resale / Restock Decision
User Story: As a Store Owner or Staff member, I want to decide whether to restock eligible items back into an active Flash Deal or discard spoiled food, so that store inventory reflects actual availability.

Name: View Shop Profile
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view my store's profile, operational status, contact information, and public storefront, so that I can review its configuration.

Name: Edit Business Info
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update my store's business address, phone number, description, and daily operating hours, so that store information remains accurate for customers.

Name: Edit Shop Images and Logo
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to upload and update store logo and banner images, so that my store profile presents an appealing and recognizable brand.

Name: View Products
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view the catalog of products managed by my store with categories, variants, and base prices, so that I can manage my food menu.

Name: View Product Detail
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view complete details of a specific product including variants, attributes, base prices, and images, so that I can manage its configuration.

Name: Create New Product
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to create a new food product with category, base attributes, variants, and images, so that it can be made available for SaveBite Flash Deals.

Name: Update Product Info
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update product names, descriptions, and category associations, so that catalog records remain accurate.

Name: Delete Product
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to delete an eligible product that has no active Flash Deals or pending orders, so that discontinued items are removed from my catalog.

Name: Update Product Images
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update and reorder gallery images for a product, so that customers have a clear visual representation of the food.

Name: Add Attributes Values
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to add new attribute values to a product and generate variant combinations, so that product variations such as sizes or flavors are properly configured.

Name: Update Variant
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update SKU, original price, and status for individual product variants, so that variant information remains accurate.

Name: Update Product Status
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to toggle a product's status between Active and Inactive, so that I can pause selling a product without deleting its historical records.

Name: View Product Flash Deal History
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view the history of Flash Deals associated with a specific product, so that I can evaluate its sales volume and past pricing performance.

Name: Create Flash Deal
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to create a new Flash Deal by selecting surplus variants, setting discounted prices, available quantities, and pickup time windows, so that surplus food can be sold before closing.

Name: Update Flash Deal
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update inventory counts and pickup times of an active or scheduled Flash Deal, so that deal details match actual available kitchen surplus.

Name: Cancel Flash Deal
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to cancel an active Flash Deal when inventory runs out unexpectedly, so that no additional orders can be placed.

Name: Unhide Flash Deal
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to unhide a previously hidden Flash Deal, so that customers can discover and order it again during its remaining validity period.

Name: Hide Flash Deal
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to temporarily hide an active Flash Deal from public discovery, so that customer ordering is paused without terminating the deal record.

Name: View Sent Staff Invitations
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view pending and expired staff invitations sent by my store, so that I can monitor recruitment progress.

Name: Revoke Staff Invitation
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to revoke a pending staff invitation, so that the invitation is cancelled before it can be accepted.

Name: Invite Customer as Staff
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to invite an eligible customer by email to join my store's staff, so that they can assist with order processing and food handover.

Name: View Staff List
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view all current staff members of my store and their access statuses, so that I can manage staff employment.

Name: View Staff Activity Log
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view the chronological log of staff operational actions (confirmations, rejections, restocks), so that I can audit staff performance and accountability.

Name: Update Staff Info
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to activate or suspend a staff member's working access, so that I can manage staff operational privileges.

Name: Remove Staff Member
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to remove a staff member from my store, so that their access to store operations is revoked.

Name: View Revenue Overview
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view net revenue metrics and sales summaries for selected time periods, so that I can monitor my store's business performance.

Name: View Order Statistics
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view order statistics categorized by status (Completed, Cancelled, No-Show), so that I can analyze order fulfillment efficiency.

Name: View Shop Flash Deal Statistics
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view performance statistics of my store's Flash Deals including sell-out rates and rescued food volume, so that I can evaluate surplus reduction.

Name: View Revenue by Payment Method
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view revenue breakdowns grouped by payment method (PayOS online vs Pay at Shop cash/QR), so that I understand customer payment trends.

Name: View PayOS Info
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view my store's connected PayOS API credentials and bank payout account, so that I can verify payment routing.

Name: Update PayOS Info
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to update and test my store's PayOS API keys and bank payout details, so that customer online payments are routed directly to my account.

Name: View Refund Requests for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view all customer refund requests submitted for my store, so that I can take timely action on customer complaints.

Name: Review Refund Details for Shop
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to inspect customer refund reasons, order items, and evidence photos, so that I can evaluate the validity of the refund claim.

Name: Accept Refund Request
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to accept an eligible customer refund request, so that the refund transitions to awaiting bank transfer.

Name: Reject Refund Request
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to reject an invalid refund claim with an explanatory reason, so that unjustified refunds are denied.

Name: Update Refund Transfer Status
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to upload a bank transfer receipt image and mark a refund as Transferred, so that the reimbursement is recorded.

Name: Generate VietQR Code for Refund
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to generate a dynamic VietQR code populated with the customer's bank details and refund amount, so that I can complete the transfer conveniently.

Name: View Warning History
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view policy violation warnings issued to my store, so that I can track compliance notices and required corrective actions.

Name: View Shop Platform Fee Statements
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view monthly platform fee statements issued to my store, so that I can monitor fee obligations owed to SaveBite.

Name: View Shop Platform Fee Statement Details
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view the itemized order breakdown, commission rates, and adjustments of a fee statement, so that I can verify fee calculations.

Name: Pay Shop Platform Fee Statement
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to pay an outstanding monthly platform fee statement online via PayOS, so that my store settles its platform obligations and avoids suspension.

Name: View Shop Platform Fee Report
User Story: As a Store Owner, I want to view an aggregated summary report of historical platform fees paid and owed, so that I can track platform overhead costs over time.

Name: View Current Platform Fee Configuration
User Story: As a Store Owner or Admin, I want to view the currently active platform fee rates and billing policies, so that I understand platform commission rules.

Name: View Shop Registration Requests
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view pending store registration applications submitted by prospective store owners, so that I can evaluate new vendor requests.

Name: View Registration Details
User Story: As an Admin, I want to inspect complete registration application data including store identity, food hygiene credentials, and business licenses, so that I can verify applicant authenticity.

Name: Approve Registration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to approve an eligible store registration application, so that the store is activated on the platform and the applicant's role is updated to Store Owner.

Name: Reject Registration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to reject an unqualified store registration with explicit feedback, so that the applicant is notified of the rejection reason.

Name: View Users
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view all platform user accounts with search and role filters, so that I can manage the user directory.

Name: View Account Details
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view comprehensive details of a user account including Trust Score, penalty history, associated stores, and roles, so that I can evaluate user standing.

Name: Update Account Status
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update a user's account status (Active, Suspended, or Banned) with a mandatory recorded reason, so that platform security and terms of service are enforced.

Name: View Category List
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view all food product categories configured on the platform, so that I can oversee product categorization.

Name: Create Category
User Story: As an Admin, I want to create a new food category with name, description, and icon, so that stores can classify their surplus products accurately.

Name: Update Category
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update an existing food category's details and display order, so that category information remains organized.

Name: Delete Category
User Story: As an Admin, I want to delete an unused food category that contains no active products, so that obsolete categories are removed.

Name: Update Category Status
User Story: As an Admin, I want to toggle a category's status between Active and Inactive, so that I can control category availability across the platform.

Name: View Products for Admin
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view products across all stores on the platform, so that I can audit product listings for safety and policy compliance.

Name: View Product Content
User Story: As an Admin, I want to review product revision history, descriptions, images, and prices, so that I can detect prohibited items or misleading information.

Name: Remove Violating Product
User Story: As an Admin, I want to remove a violating product and cancel its associated Flash Deals while honoring confirmed orders, so that policy violations are stopped.

Name: Send Violation Warning
User Story: As an Admin, I want to issue an official product-violation warning to a store with mandatory corrective instructions, so that the store owner addresses the infraction.

Name: Approve Revised Product Content
User Story: As an Admin, I want to review and approve product revisions submitted by a store following a warning, so that corrected products can be restored.

Name: View Shops
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view all stores registered on SaveBite with operational statuses and rating summaries, so that I can monitor the vendor network.

Name: View Shop Content
User Story: As an Admin, I want to review complete store details, address records, legal documentation, and status history, so that I can evaluate vendor compliance.

Name: Update Shop Status
User Story: As an Admin, I want to suspend or reactivate a store's operational status, so that non-compliant stores are barred from selling.

Name: View Level Benefits
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view benefit descriptions and PayAtShop deposit percentage rules for each Trust Level, so that I can oversee incentive structures.

Name: Update Level Benefits
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update deposit policies, percentage ranges, and benefit texts for a Trust Level, so that deposit requirements stay aligned with platform risk management.

Name: View Level Requirements
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the progression criteria (points, completed orders, completion rate) required for each Trust Level, so that I understand promotion criteria.

Name: Update Level Requirements
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update point and order thresholds required to reach a Trust Level, so that level progression remains balanced.

Name: View Level List
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the comprehensive list of all configured Trust Levels and their active states, so that I can oversee reputation tiers.

Name: Add New Level
User Story: As an Admin, I want to create a new Trust Level with integrated requirements and deposit policies in a single transaction, so that I can extend reputation tiers.

Name: Update Level Information
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update a Trust Level's name and description, so that tier labeling remains professional.

Name: Update Level Status
User Story: As an Admin, I want to activate or deactivate a Trust Level, so that I can control which reputation tiers are actively assigned to customers.

Name: View Level Configuration History
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view historical versions and modification logs of Trust Levels, so that policy changes remain fully auditable.

Name: View Penalty Rules
User Story: As a Customer or Admin, I want to view the active penalty rules governing No-Show infractions and point deductions, so that violation consequences are transparent.

Name: Update Penalty Rules
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update an existing penalty rule ensuring non-overlapping effective dates, so that penalty policies remain consistent.

Name: Add New Penalty Rule
User Story: As an Admin, I want to add a new No-Show penalty rule with specific infraction thresholds, point deductions, and effective date intervals, so that new penalty policies take effect.

Name: Delete Scheduled Penalty Rule
User Story: As an Admin, I want to delete a future scheduled penalty rule before its effective date, so that planned policy adjustments can be cancelled.

Name: View Trust Score Rules
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view general trust scoring rules and deduction event configurations, so that I can oversee reputation scoring rules.

Name: Update Trust Score Rule
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update point values and rules for deduction events, so that reputation scoring appropriately penalizes misconduct.

Name: View Platform Overview
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view a unified dashboard overview of platform key performance indicators (GMV, active users, active stores, rescued food volume), so that I can monitor overall platform health.

Name: View User Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view user growth analytics, retention metrics, and account status distributions, so that I can understand platform customer trends.

Name: View Shop Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view vendor network analytics including store counts by operating status, so that I can monitor vendor acquisition and compliance.

Name: View Revenue and Order Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view total platform GMV, order volume trends, and completion rates across time periods, so that I can assess platform marketplace liquidity.

Name: View Platform Flash Deal Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view platform-wide Flash Deal statistics and surplus rescue metrics, so that I can measure the environmental impact and deal clearance rates.

Name: View Payment and Refund Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view platform-wide payment method distributions and refund rates, so that I can monitor financial transaction reliability.

Name: View Revenue by Shop
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view revenue breakdowns by individual store for a selected period, so that I can identify top-performing vendors.

Name: View Platform Fee Statistics
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view platform commission collection metrics, collected fees, and overdue amounts across all stores, so that I can monitor platform monetization.

Name: View Scheduled Platform Fee Configurations
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view scheduled future platform fee policies and their effective start dates, so that I can review upcoming pricing changes.

Name: View Customer Feedbacks for Admin
User Story: As an Admin, I want to browse customer reviews across all platform stores with rating and keyword filters, so that I can oversee user sentiment and community standards.

Name: Moderate Feedback
User Story: As an Admin, I want to hide or delete abusive, fraudulent, or inappropriate customer reviews with an audit log record, so that platform community standards are maintained.

Name: Update Platform Fee Configuration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update the platform commission percentage, fixed fee, and grace periods with future scheduling, so that platform pricing stays aligned with business strategy.

Name: View Platform Fee Configuration History
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the chronological change history of platform fee configurations, so that pricing modifications remain auditable.

Name: Cancel Scheduled Platform Fee Configuration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to cancel a scheduled platform fee configuration before its effective date, so that planned fee revisions can be aborted.

Name: View All Shops’ Platform Fee Statements
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view monthly fee statements generated for all stores with filtering by settlement status, so that I can oversee platform billing.

Name: View Any Shop’s Platform Fee Statement Details
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the detailed order list and fee calculations of any store's fee statement, so that I can resolve billing disputes.

Name: View Platform PayOS Configuration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the platform-level central PayOS account configuration and webhook endpoints, so that I can verify central fee collection connectivity.

Name: Update Platform PayOS Configuration
User Story: As an Admin, I want to update and test platform PayOS API credentials with checksum verification, so that platform fee collection operates securely.

Name: View Platform PayOS Configuration History
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view the historical audit log of changes made to platform PayOS credentials, so that credential rotations remain traceable.

Name: View Audit Log
User Story: As an Admin, I want to search and inspect administrative audit logs with sanitized data payloads, so that all critical platform modifications are accountable.

Name: View Audit Archive List
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view monthly archived audit log files with metadata and record counts, so that I can manage long-term security archives.

Name: Create Monthly Audit Archive
User Story: As an Admin, I want to generate a monthly compressed archive of historical audit logs, so that past logs are securely packaged for long-term storage.

Name: Download Audit Archive
User Story: As an Admin, I want to download an encrypted ZIP archive containing monthly audit logs, so that audit records can be preserved offline for compliance inspection.

Name: View Archived Audit Logs
User Story: As an Admin, I want to view log records contained within a server-side audit archive file, so that historical events can be investigated without restoring old database rows.

Name: View Audit Logs from Local File
User Story: As an Admin, I want to load and inspect audit log records directly from an archived local file, so that offline forensic investigation is supported.

Name: Process Order Payment Webhook
User Story: As the PayOS Payment Gateway, I want to deliver a verified webhook notification to SaveBite upon successful customer order payment or deposit, so that order confirmation and inventory reservation are finalized automatically.

Name: Process Platform Fee Payment Webhook
User Story: As the PayOS Payment Gateway, I want to deliver a verified webhook notification to SaveBite when a store owner completes a platform fee payment, so that the store's monthly statement status is updated to Paid immediately.
